label: Inventory sandbox
notes: Manual inventory test during a short hunt. Solo guardian starts with nested bags (bag→bag→shields, adventurer backpack with spare armor/jewelry, empty jubilee organizer, rune pouch bag with field/missile stacks, loose gear in root). Pause combat and use the right-column backpack: LMB select, drag to move/swap, RMB open bags / equip, dbl-click equip/unequip, drag gear between equipment card and backpack. Nested runes exercise tree-search consume demos when casting is available. inventoryPractice keeps canvas rendering after the hunt ends so drop/pickup still works.
